record.text: Spider-Man Brand New Day comes closer to my ideal of what an MCU film should be like than any entry in the franchise since Endgame. Like a good run of comics all smooshed into two and a half hours.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day is a great movie that dives in the Peter Parker’s loneliness and how isolating yourself from those who care will only hurt you. Despite so many characters and plot developments, the movie doesn’t become a disjointed mess. This is Tom Holland’s best Spider-Man. Recommend.

record.text:
Spider-man Brand New Day is... good.

Solid script, SUPER bloated, at times feels like a 2h trailer for future movies, and I'm kinda angry about one thing that I don't think belongs in a Spider-Man movie, but... 

...they did it really well, so it's hard to be mad about it. Kind of admire it, even

I get the appeal but before you spend money on Spider-Man Brand New Day, you should know Spidey acts like those cops who use Flock cameras to track down someone they're stalking. This is not an exaggeration. He uses facial recog on all the NYC cameras to find a woman. The film is NORMALIZING that.

Really enjoyed both THE ODYSSEY and SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY. Two very different movies, both drawing packed houses and receiving audience applause at the end. 

I loved sitting next to a group of teenaged girls during BND. Movie absolutely hit for them. Laughter, tears, gasps... fully engaged.

external.description:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day proves that with the right passion, and skills, you can still do a great superhero movie, that is grounded in real life struggles.

* * *

Tom Holland is back for the fourth time as Peter Parker. After No Way Home, this is a fresh start for the character where we’re finally seeing a grounded superhero being very successful at that part of his life, while struggling in his personal life. Basically, the opposite of Sam Raimi’s second film.

It’s also a new day for the director. Known best for Shang-Chi and Wonder Man in the MCU, Destin Daniel Cretton brings his distinct action and visual style to this franchise. As a result, Spider-Man is taken to new heights.

From the distinct visual style to amazing action scenes, including with The Hand, Brand New Day brings a completely new feel to the Spider-Man franchise.

With a runtime of over two hours, I didn’t feel it being long, or short, it’s just the right length. Yes, the first ten minutes are on the slower side, it’s very well used to make us feel Peter Parker’s loneliness, and his struggle to have a personal life. Some people will actually cry watching this film. Spoilers aside, MJ makes all the right decisions in this film, and Zendaya is amazing.

Also, it was a very dumb move by Sony, and the marketing team to muzzle Sadie Sink. Sink delivers one of the best performances in the film. Plus, the “reveal” of her character doesn’t serve the movie or move the plot. It just “happens” while everyone already knew who she’s playing. So why the mystery and games? Sink deserves to talk about her character the same as Holland or Zendaya.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day – Official Trailer

##### Should you watch it?

Yes, this is the best Spider-Man has ever been. A lot of heart, a study about loneliness, and amazing action and fights.

##### Where can I watch it?

_Spider-Man: Brand New Day_ is now playing in theaters.

images.alt:
After the record-breaking global success of Spider-Man: No Way Home, Spider-Man:
Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man.
Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he's devoted himself entirely to protecting his city - a full-time Spider-Man - but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

73. Spider-Man: Brand New Day

Although the pacing of the film’s plot can move a bit too slow at times, this is the most mature and lived in that Spider-Man’s world has felt before, concerned with its characters and their internal lives that previous live action films have never fully explored.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day

On paper, this is juggling a lot but aside from one character, its honestly handled pretty well. The focus is still on Peter's arc which is really well handled and the general presentation compared to the previous Holland movies is much improved

images.alt:
After the record-breaking global success of Spider-Man: No Way Home, Spider-Man:
Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man.
Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he's devoted himself entirely to protecting his city - a full-time Spider-Man - but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day

Highly recommended!

Spider-Man: Brand New Day - Man, this whole movie kinda shows how sauceless Tom Hollands' previous Spidey outings were.  I still like those movies, especially No Way Home but this movie just looks so much better.  The swinging scenes are fantastic and the cinematography is miles better here.

Saw Spider-Man: Brand New Day & it was amazing. Lotta fun( particularly the homages to famous covers in the opening sequence) & it had a great plot twist on the nature of the protagonists( super excellent reason why Sadie Sink's role was so closely guarded).
